column1: # Every numeric level authored inside a library organ, with its disposition.
# THE LAW: a level is either read off the material or declared by the caller. It is never
# authored inside the organ. See canon/THE_AUTHORED_LEVEL.md.
# MATERIAL  a fact that cannot vary; `why` names the theorem.
# ABI       hardware, wire format, or foreign interface.
# APERTURE  declared, returns its outside, and `why` states what would derive it.
# PIN       a contaminant; `why` carries the excision plan.

Two occurrences before a route commits. Declared, and the withheld routes are RETURNED as lineage rather than discarded. To derive: the recurrence a receiver requires is that receiver\u2019s declaration, and belongs with it.

Declared and refused past, and the Chow ring of a matroid grows super-exponentially in the ground set. To derive: the level follows from the caller\u2019s memory declaration, which should be supplied rather than assumed.
As GROUND_APERTURE.

A truncation of an exact series with a RETAINED remainder certificate. `exact_value.rs::SeriesTailCertificate` is the carrier and the remainder is an exact rational interval, so the outside IS returned. To derive: the terms needed follow from the requested enclosure width, which the caller should declare.
A vertex of the flat triangular lattice has coordination 6, and the angular defect is measured against it. Theorem: six equilateral triangles tile 2\u03c0 exactly. This does not vary.
An AVL tree over a `usize`-indexed population has depth < 1.4405\u00b7log2(n+2); 128 exceeds any population addressable on a 64-bit carrier. Theorem, not a budget.
2^61-1 is the Mersenne prime M61, so the fold is over a field. Theorem, not a budget.

EXCISE. Not a fact about quintics -- a REFUSAL GATE at :77 plus seven fixed-size-5 arrays including `type Permutation5 = [u8; 5]`. The organ cannot see a quartic or a sextic, so `solvable_by_radicals` refusing degree 5 has no degree to contrast against. Replace: read the degree off the polynomial; `Permutation5` -> a general permutation. `rational_polynomial.rs` already carries general-degree resultants and Sturm sequences.

EXCISE by MOVING, not by deleting. Its own doc calls it "a call budget as well as a memory bound", which is the admission. The lawful form is a receiver-declared aperture supplied by the CALLER, with the refusal naming what the material would have required. The organ does not get to pin it.

EXCISE by moving to the caller. The refusal shape is lawful -- `GaugeApertureExceeded` rather than sampling -- but nothing derives 12. 2^12 = 4096 is a machine-capacity guess in an aperture\u2019s clothes.
EXCISE. 18 is the RELAMPAGO fixture\u2019s coordinate count -- one experiment\u2019s material fixed into the organ that reads it.
EXCISE. The horizon is the transport law\u2019s own fixed point, not 64 doublings.
EXCISE. The fold should come from the incidence, not be authored at 3.
EXCISE with LEADER_WITNESS_DEPTH; the grain follows the same law.

EXCISE. A leader whose witness depth is ONE takes a single step; that is not a leader. `leader_quadrature.rs` carries the law -- each extension changes the material the next extension reads -- and the depth is whatever the material stopped it at. Replace with the returned extension count.
EXCISE. An affine form in n variables has n+1 coefficients, so 4 pins the ambient dimension at 3. Same replacement.

EXCISE. A quadric in n variables has C(n+2,2) coefficients, so 10 pins the AMBIENT DIMENSION at 3 while the name reads as a coefficient count. `ExactAffineVersionFiber::new` already takes the count, so the machinery is dimension-agnostic and only the caller pins it. Replace with `(n+2)(n+1)/2` from a declared dimension.
EXCISE by moving to the caller. `DEFAULT_` names the defect: a default is a level the organ picked because the caller was not asked.
EXCISE, same defect and same replacement as arithmetic_monodromy. The Tschirnhaus line IS transport between degrees; pinning the degree removes the thing being transported.
EXCISE. Same root-separation bound; 200 is arbitrary.
EXCISE. Three channels pins the receiver family; the count is a declaration of the material presented.
EXCISE. 512 truncates a RETURNED POPULATION, which CLAUDE.md \u00a79 forbids -- the artifact is the return and a count is never a substitute. Return the population whole.
EXCISE by moving to the caller. The occurrence window is a receiver declaration, not a module fact.
EXCISE with REFINEMENT_APERTURE, same bound.

EXCISE. 64 halvings is 2^-64 of the starting width and 64 is a familiar number, not a derived one. The halvings needed to separate two roots are determined by the ROOT SEPARATION, computable from the discriminant by a Mahler/Davenport bound. Replace with that bound; a construction exceeding it is then a genuine defect rather than a budget overrun.
